recent_posts: The tenge reached 464.7 against the dollar, rising to its strongest level in 95 days. It has strengthened 9.37% since the start of the year, having traded at 538.6 a year ago. #Kazakhstan $KZT

The Moroccan dirham reached 9.301 to the dollar, its strongest level in 58 days, within a trading range that has not exceeded 1.1% over the past month. The five independent sources used in setting the rate disagreed by 0.39%, against a typical disagreement of 0.12%. #Morocco $MAD
The tugrik held near 3,598 to the dollar, little changed over the past week. It is down 1.0% since the start of the year and is now at its weakest point of the past year. #Mongolia $MNT

The Argentine peso rose 0.92% against the dollar, its largest daily gain in 74 days, to reach 1,492. Even so, it has fallen 5.6% over the past 90 days and 12.6% from its high for the year. #Argentina $ARS
